statement: A scorer stopped crediting a workflow as CI only when a reader proved it did nothing but upload. Real release workflows build first, so the issue's own reproductions stayed credited, filed as a recall reduction. The decision never needed that strong claim: 'an unconditional step publishes' was weaker, true wherever it fired, and enough. Rules: before leaving a defect open as unprovable, name the weakest true claim that justifies the decision, and test that one.
